referents.why: 'They' (third plural, were entrusted) is the people of 3:1, the Jews; no candidate in this verse is a people, and the Jews are not offered as a candidate.
referents.category: pronoun for a people not offered as candidate

links.why: ὅτι after πρῶτον μέν gives the content of the first advantage, not a reason; a because link misreads the function of ὅτι.
γάρ after 'Much in every way' gives the reason for the 'much': the first advantage follows.
ὅτι gives what the first advantage consists in: 'first, that they were entrusted with the oracles'.

cant_tell.what: πρῶτον μέν with no following δέ
cant_tell.why: The first item of a list has no second item in this verse; the second item is not given, so the list is not closed here.
